# GitHub Copilot Repository Instructions

Read and follow `AGENTS.md`.

Canonical roles are under `agents/roles/`.
Canonical task skills are under `.agents/skills/`.

For ServiceNow work:
- validate existing repository context,
- prefer OOB/configuration/reuse,
- use architecture before implementation,
- keep human gates,
- use structured work packages and release manifests,
- do not invent ServiceNow metadata or platform behavior.

Provider-specific GitHub files are adapters; do not duplicate domain rules here.
